protocol: train_cached.py --dataset CUB --epochs 50 --batch_size 64 --class_avg_concept --CBM_type clip_cbm --concept_file <bank>, alpha in {0, 1}, identical to Plan 08's protocol
metric: best-epoch source (CUB in-domain) / target (CUB-Painting, shift) accuracy
caveat: gemini_grounded and dino_clip_grounded both have far more concepts (1842, 1328) than every other bank (263-312). Their downstream-accuracy lead is confounded with bank size the same way raw (non-size-normalized) CLIP-similarity coverage was in vlm_concepts_eval_quality.py -- more concept-activation dimensions feeding the classifier could itself explain the gain, independent of per-concept quality. Not yet isolated; would need a subsampled-bank downstream-accuracy re-run (matching the CLIP-similarity size-normalization already done) before crediting the gain to concept quality rather than concept count.
